core_obligations: Affine base; closed-immersion approximation X = lim X_i with fibre dimensions bounded at a finite level; transfer R^p f_* through the closed immersion and Leray.
Quotient reduction: F a quotient of a finite-presented F'; the kernel has H^{d+1} = 0 by the vanishing lemma, so H^d(X,F') -> H^d(X,F) is surjective.

Noetherian base + coherent descent: X_0 -> Y_0 finite type, proper eventually, fibres bounded, F_0 coherent pulling back to F; lemma-top-cohomology-functor gives H^d(X,F) = H^d(X_0,F_0) \otimes_R R; Noetherian finiteness finishes.
proof_roadmap: Approximate X by proper fp closed-immersion system.
difficulty_reason: Four-stage reduction chain: closed-immersion approximation of X, quotient reduction to finite-presented sheaves via the vanishing of H^{d+1}, Noetherian base approximation, and coherent descent via lemma-top-cohomology-functor; ends at the Noetherian finiteness theorem.
